rule: FILE-LEVEL consumer rule. tests/fixtures/** is harness DATA: the files named test_*.py there are vendored controls that the listed normal tests copy into a run directory and execute explicitly (or read byte-for-byte); pytest must not collect them directly (tests/conftest.py collect_ignore). Every entry must have at least one consumer; the map is checked by tests/test_fixture_coverage_map.py.
method: static reference scan of the normal test modules; FILE-LEVEL: a consumer must name the control file (relative path under tests/fixtures/ or bare filename as a whole token); directory entries are informational (no execution)
